text:
maya: Quick heads-up — drafting the internal release note for 2026-03-01 patch. Need final pin matrix + rollback decision before 4pm PT. Staging deploy scheduled for 15:30. cc @alex @jordan

alex: On it. Will paste pin table in a minute. Do we pin default to model v3.1 or keep v2.8 as default and use v3.1 as canary?

jordan: v3.1 showed some regressions on long prompts in yesterday's canary. My vote: default -> v2.8, canary -> v3.1 in EU only.

sam: Agree with jordan. Suggest rollout cadence: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 30m pause checks between ramps. Rollback window: immediate if error rate >2x baseline or quality drop >5%.

lucy: Ops question — can we fall back to the CPU quantized variant if GPU pool gets saturated? ops-bot forecast looked tight around 15:00 PT.

ops-bot: ops-bot: current dedicated GPU reserved capacity = 8 GPUs. Forecasted peak at 15:00 PT = 92% util for the day; no burst buffer available without scaling request.

maya: OK. Plan: pin default -> v2.8, canary -> v3.1 (eu-west-1). Rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 30m pause. Rollback triggers: quality regression >5% on our eval harness OR error_rate >2x baseline OR latency p95 >2x normal. I'll include these in the RN.

alex: Draft RN blurb: "Fix: memory leak in kv-cache; Performance: -12% median latency for common chat flows; Known issue: small regressions on longform prompts in v3.1." Ping for wording.

jordan: tiny nit — median (p50) improved; p99 unchanged. Also add a note about the new quant profile name: `q3a`.

sam: I'll update the deploybot playbook. Rollout command pattern we use: `/deploy canary --model v3.1 --percent 10 --region eu-west-1` then `/deploy ramp --to 50` etc. Will add the rollback command: `/deploy rollback --to v2.8`.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: received command `/deploy staging --model v3.1 --percent 10 --region eu-west-1`. Running preflight checks.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: preflight OK. Starting canary rollout to staging at 15:30 PT.

maya: Can someone drop the staging link + quick smoke checklist? I'll attach to the RN before I send the internal blast.

alex: staging link: https://staging.redwood-inference.internal/releases/2026-03-01-build-5492
Smoke checklist:
- Sanity chat flows (short + long prompts)
- Embedding vector sanity (consistency)
- Small eval harness quick-run (longform + shortform)
- Error rate + latency dashboard check

jordan: Running the eval harness now against v3.1 canary. Will share CSV in ~20m.

sam: If smoke fails, fallback procedure: 1) stop rollout, 2) run `/deploy rollback --to v2.8`, 3) set pin at router level to v2.8, 4) notify eng-oncall + ops.

maya: :thumbsup: Agree. I'll include the short rollback steps and contact list in RN (ops@, eng-oncall@).

ops-bot: ops-bot: alert thresholds configured for this rollout — error_rate_warn=1.5%, error_rate_critical=3%, latency_p95 threshold=2x baseline. Canary monitors: latency p95, error_rate, eval_quality_score.

alex: Added RN note: "Pin enforced at router level; ops will unpin after 1 business day if metrics stay green."

lucy: Can we add a short FAQ line: "How to request rollback" with the 4-step fallback? Might save time.

maya: Yes — will add a one-paragraph FAQ + step-by-step commands.

jordan: Eval quick-run results: v3.1 canary shows 0.8% quality regression on longform tests (CSV attached to the thread).

sam: Given <1% regression and the latency improvements, proceed but we'll keep an extended watch (1 hour). I'll tag eng-oncall to monitor.

maya: Final decision for RN: pin default -> v2.8; start canary EU v3.1 at 10% now; ramp to 50% after 30m if metrics stable; internal blast once at 50% + 30m stable.

alex: I'll prep blast copy. Draft: "Internal: rolling update to routing and model versions. Default remains v2.8; EU canary v3.1 at 10%. See RN link for rollback steps and monitoring."

maya: Perfect — thanks. I'll finalize RN and post link here when live.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout to staging at 10% started at 15:30 PT. Monitoring enabled.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: ramp to 50% completed at 16:00 PT — no critical alerts in first 30m.

maya: RN published (internal): https://internal.redwood/docs/rn/2026-03-01-canary-v3.1-pin-v2.8 — internal blast queued. :megaphone:
